children: META's Muse AI launched Sept 8, hit No.1 on U.S. App Store, ~2.5–2.8M downloads in 12 days and ~557K daily users by Sept 19; offers free plus $20/$100 plans, Shopify and PayPal integrations.
Meta Platforms (META): Counterpoint’s H1 2026 report finds Llama base models power 38% of adapted sovereign LLMs surveyed, making Llama the most used foreign base model across regions.
Meta Platforms (META) rolled out Muse AI, an agent that browses sites, fills forms and makes purchases with user approval. It runs in a Secure VM and stores credentials in protected vaults.
Meta Platforms (META) unveils Muse monetization: free basic tier plus paid plans ~ $20/month for extra features and up to ~$100/month for heavy users; pricing varies by usage intensity.
Bank of America reissued Buy on Meta Platforms (META) with $810 target, citing Muse's early traction boosting sentiment around Meta's AI strategy and consumer product linkage to AI spend.
Meta unveils Petal, a ~7,000 km, petabit-scale subsea cable linking US and France for private, low-latency AI model training. Target capacity 1 Pb/s; service planned for 2029; partners NEC, Sumitomo.
Meta Platforms (META) faces heavy AI infrastructure funding needs, driving broader credit spreads and prompting some hyperscalers to issue higher-yield new debt.
UBS says Muse could add a trading-like revenue channel for Meta Platforms (META) by executing transactions for users, complementing its subscription and ad businesses.
Rosenblatt kept a Buy on Meta Platforms (META) with an $886 target, citing upcoming products like camera‑free smart glasses “Luna” supporting AI interactions and multi‑mic audio.
Meta (META) inked a multi-year deal with Corning worth up to $6B for optical fiber, cabling and connectivity hardware for U.S. data centers; Corning to expand domestic production to support supply.
